verdict.rationale: Lambda's filesystem docs describe an S3-compatible adapter that lets you copy files to and from filesystems with tools like rclone and s5cmd. Billing docs say there are no ingress or egress charges, which supports moving data efficiently. Missing for 10: documented endpoint and credential setup details, a native cloud-storage sync feature, transfer-performance figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling

citations.quote: This adapter allows you to use S3-compatible tools like rclone and s5cmd to copy files to and from your filesystems and perform common file operations.
There is no minimum storage period, and you are not charged for ingress or egress.
